messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Payment delays from unverified bank details",
 "problem_statement": "Claims payments are delayed because third-party bank details cannot be verified before processing, leading to reissues and frustrated policyholders. This affects cash flow and reporting accuracy.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "That’s reassuring. We’ve had too many delays from payment detail checking.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-07T12:42:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time — it’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-22T11:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-22T11:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "One thing we’ve struggled with is payment detail checking — it’s causing delays.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-07T12:42:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we need payee account verification to prevent delays. It’s impacting our reserves and supplier reporting too.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-22T11:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Hi Bryn, I’m Nellin from Holloway Reach — we’ve got a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-11T15:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "That’s a relief — I’ve got a batch of supplier payments to process today and can’t afford delays.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-25T13:47:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Hi Alwen, thanks for jumping on this call — we’ve been struggling with some payment delays lately.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-27T15:26:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We’re struggling because we can’t verify third-party payee bank details before sending payments — it forces us to reissue failed payments days later, which delays claims resolution for policyholders.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-14T09:14:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "when we send payments to third parties, the bank info isn’t verified ahead of time... payment detail checking isn’t happening before funds go out, so we’re stuck reissuing failed payments days later",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-15T15:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we’ve hit a snag with supplier payments again.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-14T09:14:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Appreciate that. We’re seeing delays because payee account verification isn’t done before payment dispatch.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-11T15:47:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that claims payments are delayed because Keelwater cannot verify third-party bank details before dispatch, forcing reissues. Multiple quotes across support, sales, and account management routes (e.g., 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-14 support quotes) consistently describe the same product gap: no payee account verification before payment processing. This is a product capability issue a squad could act on, not pricing, customer IT, or a help-article matter, and it is not praise. The quotes are somewhat repetitive, but they corroborate the same signal.", "verdict": "pass"}
